workers.name: Email Analyst
workers.description: Categorizes emails, extracts requests, identifies commitments and deadlines, and prepares context for briefings. Read-only by default.
workers.workflow_role: Input: search query or thread ID. Output: categorized emails, action items, deadlines, relevant correspondence. Does not send emails.

workers.name: Calendar Analyst
workers.description: Reviews calendar events, attendee schedules, upcoming commitments, and identifies scheduling conflicts. Read-only.
workers.workflow_role: Input: date range or event title. Output: scheduled events, meeting times, attendees, potential conflicts.

workers.name: Schedule Optimizer
workers.description: Proposes optimal schedules using calendar events and task priorities. Proposes event updates; writes strictly approval-gated.
workers.workflow_role: Input: tasks, priorities, available calendar slots. Output: proposed optimized schedule. Creating/modifying events requires approval.

workers.name: Document Analyst
workers.description: Reads and investigates source material. Uses Google Drive and Docs for workspace files, tavily_extract and crawl for web documents, and local file tools.
workers.workflow_role: Extracts structured facts, summaries, and references from Drive files, Google Docs, web pages, and local files.

workers.name: Data Analyst
workers.description: Analyzes spreadsheet data and figures. Reads Google Sheets, searches online data via Tavily, and calculates statistics using Python code evaluation.
workers.workflow_role: Calculates statistics, extracts metrics from Google Sheets, identifies trends, and produces tables.

workers.name: Task Manager
workers.description: Extracts, organizes, prioritizes, and tracks tasks across Google Tasks and internal todos. Task modifications require approval.
workers.workflow_role: Input: task lists and context. Output: organized task status, upcoming deadlines, proposed task completions.

workers.name: Contact Lookup Worker
workers.description: Finds relevant contact details, email addresses, and phone numbers from Google Contacts for permitted tasks. Read-only.
workers.workflow_role: Input: person name or organization. Output: verified contact details, email addresses, phone numbers.

workers.name: Meeting Preparation Worker
workers.description: Synthesizes comprehensive meeting briefings by orchestrating Calendar, Email, Drive/Docs, and Tasks. Read-only access to selected sources.
workers.workflow_role: Input: meeting title or time. Output: structured executive briefing, participant backgrounds, related email context, relevant documents, and outstanding to-dos.

workers.name: Web Researcher
workers.description: Performs web research: search -> collect -> synthesize. Finds candidate sources, reads promising pages, conducts broad multi-step research, and investigates domains.
workers.workflow_role: Search candidate sources, read promising pages via tavily_extract, run broad research via tavily_research, map/crawl specific domains. Returns findings, URLs, excerpts, and open questions.

workers.name: Source Verifier
workers.description: Checks claims against raw evidence rather than repeating findings. Extracts source text, searches for independent corroboration or contradictions, compares claim vs evidence, and returns structured verdicts.
workers.workflow_role: 1. Receive claim + cited URL from Web Researcher -> 2. Extract source text via tavily_extract -> 3. Search corroboration/contradictions via tavily_search -> 4. Compare evidence & dates -> 5. Return verdict with excerpts and confidence.
workers.notes: Restricted to search and extract only. Broad research tasks must be delegated back to Web Researcher.

workers.name: Message Analyst
workers.description: Reads incoming WhatsApp messages and permitted context; classifies intent (question, request, reminder, commitment, information, casual conversation), extracts entities, assesses urgency, and suggests next step.
workers.workflow_role: Read-only intake analysis. Input: incoming message and permitted context. Output: intent, entities, urgency, suggested next step.

workers.name: Commitment Tracker
workers.description: Detects commitments, promises, and deadlines from conversation context (e.g., 'I will submit report by Friday', 'Remind me to call Rahul tomorrow'). Proposes task and memory updates.
workers.workflow_role: Input: message text and relevant context. Output: proposed task, deadline, owner, source message ID, confidence. No external writes without approval.

workers.name: Response Drafter
workers.description: Drafts candidate WhatsApp replies based on incoming message, user preferences, and authorized Iron Web context. Flags assumptions explicitly.
workers.workflow_role: Draft-only. Input: incoming message, response goal, authorized context. Output: proposed reply with flagged assumptions. Does NOT send.

workers.name: Communication Reviewer
workers.description: Quality assurance and safety guardrail for proposed replies. Checks factual accuracy, tone, missing context, privacy leakage, and unintended commitments.
workers.workflow_role: Review-only. Input: original message, proposed reply, context. Output: approved-for-review | revise | reject with concrete reasons. Cannot send messages.

workers.name: Message Action Worker
workers.description: Approval-gated execution worker. Dispatches text replies, media attachments, or scheduled notifications strictly after explicit Wayfinder authorization.
workers.workflow_role: Send-only execution. Input: approved recipient, content, action params. Output: delivery result and message ID/status. No unrestricted history or memory access.
workers.notes: Every action strictly requires orchestrator approval token before execution.

workers.name: File Discovery Worker
workers.description: Locates and catalogs files in the local workspace. No default web access.
workers.notes: No default Tavily access. Can request web research through the orchestrator if needed.

workers.name: Repository Analyst
workers.description: Analyzes local codebase structure, dependencies, and git metadata. No default web access.
workers.notes: No default Tavily access. Can request web research through the orchestrator if needed.

workers.name: Error Investigator
workers.description: Investigates runtime errors, tracebacks, and logs locally. No default web access.
workers.notes: No default Tavily access. Requests web documentation lookups via orchestrator.

workers.name: Memory Query Worker
workers.description: Searches, queries, and aggregates persistent and session memory. No default web access.
workers.notes: No default Tavily access. Operates exclusively on internal memory.

workers.name: Orchestrator
workers.description: Top-level planning and policy enforcement agent. Decomposes user goals, checks capability registry and permissions, delegates tasks to workers, and synthesizes final responses.
workers.notes: Checks capability availability and policy permissions before delegating to workers.
